title: Casus irreducibilis / Bombelli bridge
summary: Cubic with three real roots can force cube roots of complex intermediates in Cardano’s formula; Bombelli (1572) treats them algebraically and recovers real roots—complex as a bridge, not as ‘fake’ answers. Descartes’ pejorative ‘imaginary’ misleads.

title: Three centuries to geometry
summary: Wessel–Argand–Gauss make the plane picture precise: numbers as rotations and scalings. Applications: AC/telecom phasors; digital media via Fourier; modern tech stack depends on C.

title: Roadmap toward RH-style peaks
summary: Series teases 4D graphing via domain coloring; analytic continuation; journey from rotation idea toward Riemann zeta / RH. LO6: popular arc, not a course proof of RH.
